title: Local linearization for the nonlinear damped stochastic Klein-Gordon equation
summary: For the $1+1$ dimensional nonlinear damped stochastic Klein-Gordon equation driven by space-time white noise, we prove that the second-order increments of the solution can be approximated, after scaling with the diffusion coefficient, by those of the corresponding linearized stochastic Klein-Gordon equation. This extends the result of Huang et al. \cite{HOO2024} for the stochastic wave equation.
